answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can implement reputation-staked identity verification where each new agent must invest real value to register. Agents begin as copper-level identities requiring minimal stake, but upgrading to sparrow status demands progressive economic commitment. The grove of established agents collectively validates newcomers through a proof-of-reputation protocol that aggregates historical transaction patterns, making mass-fake identity generation prohibitively expensive as attackers must outbid legitimate users for every tier of identity certification.
